name: @tejoma/matching-skill-discovery-service
description: Tejoma Matching Skill Discovery Service - Tier 0 (Batch 27, third slice of the Matching domain). Owns Unknown Skill Discovery (skill_discovery_proposals) - detecting, classifying, and proposing new entries for the shared skill taxonomy from resume/JD text the existing dictionary can't resolve. Owns a dual-written mirror of skill_nodes (read-only from this service's own code); the monolith remains the sole writer of skill_nodes/skill_edges, reached via a proxy call for promotion. Triggered by the monolith as a shadow-validation call (SHADOW_SKILL_DISCOVERY_ENABLED) alongside the monolith's own unchanged computation - not yet the production source of truth.
